description: Handwritten letters, notes, records, and manuscripts — full text extraction
notes: Handwritten documents use full-text extraction rather than structured field extraction. The LLM transcribes the content verbatim. All output goes into the 'content' field. Operator review is typically triggered by the fixed 0.65 confidence assigned by olmOCR.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Complete verbatim transcription of all handwritten text in the document, preserving original line breaks and paragraph structure

fields.name: author_name
fields.description: Name of the person who wrote or signed the document, if legible

fields.name: document_date
fields.description: Date appearing in the document, if present

fields.name: recipient_name
fields.description: Name of the person the document is addressed to, if applicable

fields.name: document_language
fields.description: Primary language of the document content
